# Awais Law Associates

> Lahore-based law firm representing businesses, financial institutions, and private clients in corporate, banking, civil, criminal (NAB/FIA), tax, family, and arbitration matters across Pakistan. Led by Advocate High Court Muhammad Awais Ahsan Joiya, Former Assistant Advocate General, Punjab.

## Practice Areas
- [Civil & Property Litigation](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#civil): boundary disputes, adverse possession, tenancy, recovery suits.
- [Corporate & Commercial](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#corporate): SECP compliance, M&A, contracts, company formation.
- [Banking & Financial Litigation](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#banking): NPL recovery, loan defaults, financial fraud defence.
- [Constitutional Litigation](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#constitutional): writ petitions, service tribunal appeals.
- [Criminal & NAB/FIA Defence](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#criminal): NAB references, bail, accountability court litigation.
- [Revenue, Tax & Land Law](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#revenue-land): FBR disputes, tax appeals, land mutation.
- [Trademark & IP](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#ip): trademark and patent registration and enforcement.
- [Overseas Pakistanis Legal Services](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#overseas): property, succession, and inheritance matters for the diaspora.
- [Arbitration](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#arbitration): domestic and foreign arbitral award enforcement.
- [Family Law & Matrimonial Matters](https://www.awaislawassociates.com/practice-areas#family-law): khula, divorce, custody, maintenance, dower recovery.
